_comment: Positions ledger for report.py. The trading session maintains it: a buy APPENDS, a sell REMOVES. sleeve = swing|momentum (NO 'legacy' — every position is judged each run with a take-profit / trail / hold / thesis-check action; treat the book as an income / grow-the-balance portfolio). Stops are TRAILING: a winner carries a GTC stop ~15% below its running high, ratcheted UP only and never below entry, so it can only ever be sold for a locked-in gain; underwater names carry NO price stop and are thesis-managed (sell only if the thesis breaks, else cull at the monthly rebalance). Options positions (sleeve:'options') may carry a 'manual_hold_override' field to suspend ONLY the mechanical -50% price stop (see CLAUDE.md HARD RULE 8) — settable/clearable only by a genuinely interactive session with a real, live Ryan turn, never by an automated run (same bar as HARD RULE 9).

Standing exit plan re-read before judging and followed, not reinterpreted: this is Ryan's 2026-08-05 Aug-Oct drawdown insurance, EXPLICITLY EXEMPT from the DTE-scaled premium backstops, and its next decision is the ~21-DTE roll/close review WITH Ryan (~2026-10-30), never mechanical. Mark 6.185 at 14:46Z, -17.42% / -$130.50 on the $7.49 entry, 98 DTE. CORRECTION TO THE PRIOR RUN'S FRAMING, and it is the useful thing this run has to say about the hedge: the 14:30Z run recorded a 'FIFTH consecutive uptick' (6.035 -> 6.10 -> 6.135 -> 6.175 -> 6.265) and called the last one 'EARNED rather than drifted' because SPY had gone red and VIX had ticked up. Fifteen minutes later that entire increment is gone -- SPY recovered from -0.11% to -0.08% (777.02 -> 777.27) and the mark fell 6.265 -> 6.185, back to within half a cent of Thursday's 6.18 close. So the position is FLAT on the session, not green, and the five-uptick sequence was a 40-minute artifact of a few tenths of index drift, not a signal. LESSON FOR THE NEXT RUN: do not build a narrative out of a 98-DTE, -0.14-delta hedge's intraday mark. At this delta a 0.1% index wiggle moves the mark more than anything meaningful, and describing those wiggles as 'earned' invites someone downstream to read direction into noise. Report the number, judge the thesis, move on. Neither limb of setup_invalidation is met: SPY 777.27 is nowhere near decisively above ~800, and Ryan has not lifted the posture.
